title: Account status and lockout
caption: `platform.accounts.status`. The sign-in lockout is `locked_until` (5 failures → 15 min), not the `locked` status, which no code writes.

states.label: pending_verification
states.detail: Can sign in; access token `ev=false` reaches only `portal_unverified` operations.

states.label: active
states.detail: Verified e-mail; full portal access (subject to roles).

states.label: locked out (locked_until ahead)
states.detail: `423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED` with Retry-After; `status` stays as it was. The failure count is cleared only by a successful sign-in or adminUnlockAccount, so after 15 min each further wrong password locks again.

states.label: disabled
states.detail: adminDisableAccount: every session family revoked, `staffdeny:acct:<id>` written; tokens answer `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` at once; a correct password at sign-in answers `403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED`.

states.label: locked (reserved)
states.detail: In the CHECK and types; never written. Bug: the admin Accounts filter "Locked" therefore always lists nothing.

states.label: deleted (erased, reserved)
states.detail: Treated as unknown at sign-in; no API sets it.

transitions.label: 15 min passed + correct password / adminUnlockAccount (status unchanged throughout)
